data.body: **P2 — Do not drain completions after ending their enclosing spans.** This final drain runs after the Invocation span and, for terminal executions, Workflow span have ended. If `onOperationChange` queues a completion while the final `forceFlush()` is pending, `drainAndFlush()` exports it afterward, placing a child or continuation outside its immutable parent interval. Establish the completion cutoff before ending parent spans, then perform only `flushTracerProvider()` afterward; do not create spans for post-cutoff updates on this instance. Apply the same ordering to `InvocationOtelPlugin` and add a regression that delivers an update while the second/final flush is blocked.
